# TempQue

> Temporary email service with CLI tool for AI Agents

TempQue provides disposable email addresses. Install the CLI for programmatic access:

## CLI Tool

Install: npm i -g @tempque/cli

Setup: tempque config set api-url https://moemail.app && tempque config set api-key YOUR_KEY

Commands:
- tempque create --domain <domain> --expiry <1h|24h|3d|permanent> --json
- tempque list --json
- tempque list --email-id <id> --json
- tempque wait --email-id <id> --timeout <seconds> --json
- tempque read --email-id <id> --message-id <id> --json
- tempque send --email-id <id> --to <addr> --subject <subj> --content <body> --json
- tempque delete --email-id <id> --json

Typical workflow: create email → use address for signup → wait for verification → read content → extract code → delete

All commands support --json for structured output. Exit code 0 = success, 1 = failure, 2 = auth error.
